state.seed_assertion: Consultation with data protection officers and where appropriate with individuals and relevant experts is a requirement in the DPIA process.

sentences.1: Consultation with data protection officers and where appropriate with individuals and relevant experts is a requirement in the DPIA process.
sentences.2: You should consult your data protection officer (if you have one) and, where appropriate, individuals and relevant experts.
sentences.3: Legal advice or advice from independent experts such as IT experts, sociologists or ethicists should be considered where appropriate, though there are no specific requirements to do so.
sentences.4: DPIAs are relevant to Data Protection Officers and those with specific data protection responsibilities in larger organisations.
sentences.5: We also recommend you consider seeking legal advice or advice from other independent experts such as IT experts, sociologists or ethicists where appropriate.
sentences.6: A DPIA must involve the opinion of the Data Protection Officer and, where appropriate, the point of view of data subjects or their representatives.
sentences.7: Organizations should consult individuals and other relevant stakeholders when carrying out a DPIA.
sentences.8: We consider how best to consult individuals (or their representatives) and other relevant stakeholders.
sentences.9: The advice and recommendations of the DPO should be recorded in a DPIA where relevant and the DPIA should be signed off by appropriate people.
sentences.10: A DPIA should explain how the organization plans to support the relevant information rights of data subjects.
sentences.11: An exception to DPIA requirements applies when processing is based on legal obligation or public task if specific conditions are met.
sentences.12: Relevant government authorities must consult the Commissioner during preparation of legislative or regulatory measures that relate to processing.
